info.name: Pinterest Pink Aesthetic Theme
info.description: This custom theme transforms Pinterest's interface into a soft, cohesive pink and white aesthetic. Featuring blush pink tones for backgrounds, buttons, and text, it creates a calming, visually appealing environment while maintaining a clean, minimalist look. The grid, profile sections, and navigation menu are all styled with complementary pink hues, ensuring a smooth and pleasant user experience.
info.additionalInfo:
Additional Info:
Background Color: #fce4ec (soft blush pink)
Button Colors: #ec9ec0 (accent pink), #d78ba9 (hover effect)
Hover Effects: Slightly darker shades of pink for buttons and pins
Text Color: #5a5a5a (neutral gray for readability)
Pin Grid Style: Light pink (#f8e3eb) for grid items and darker pink on hover
Search Bar Style: Soft blush pink with accent borders
Profile Section: Blush pink background with neutral text for a minimalistic feel
